stories.headline: US senators probe Meta AI glasses over privacy risks
stories.subtitle: Sens. Ron Wyden and Edward Markey asked Meta to explain its smart-glasses safeguards — accidental recording, indicator tampering, and whether bystander footage trains AI — with answers requested by Nov. 26. Expect customers to ask about the recording light.

stories.headline: Meta partners with CNIB to bring AI glasses to blind Canadians
stories.subtitle: Meta is funding CNIB and donating AI glasses through its Come to Work employment program for Canadians who are blind, Deafblind or have low vision, with peer-led training and feedback shaping future accessibility features.

stories.headline: Meta Q3: Quest sales fell, AI glasses growth cushioned the drop
stories.subtitle: Reality Labs revenue fell 6% to $443 million as weaker Quest sales outweighed continued strong AI-glasses growth. Meta says future VR hardware ships only on a major breakthrough — the spring-2027 VR Glasses are the next bet.

stories.headline: Blind veterans receive AI glasses at UT Austin
stories.subtitle: Blind veterans gathered at UT Austin for one-on-one training on Meta's AI glasses, part of Meta's pledge of 130,000 pairs nationwide. The glasses help with navigation, reading mail and shopping hands-free — a strong accessibility talking point.

stories.headline: Wired: camera-free Audio glasses are Meta's best smart glasses yet
stories.subtitle: Wired calls the camera-free Audio glasses Meta's best yet: 43-gram frames, 12-hour battery, solid open-ear sound and live translation via the Meta AI app — with no camera, so nobody thinks you're recording them.
